description: A semiabstract pitched roof with a gray dormer stretches across the length of this landscape-oriented composition. Two chimneys emerge from the top of the roof into a pale blue sky. The dormer is bluish-gray and has a brown window divided into four panes of glass. The entire roof is rendered in soft, watery shades of pink and blue that could denote areas of light and shadow and portions covered in snow. Within a light pink patch on the left side of the composition, the word "pink" is written in pencil. Directly above this, the word "blue" is written in the strip of sky.
imageCaption: Image has not been color proofed to current standards, and its colors may differ from the original work. The Museum will replace it when new photography becomes available.
